archiveTitle: Daily Brief | League of Legends unveils New Dawn overhaul

entries.headline: League of Legends unveils its major 2027 New Dawn update
entries.summary: AUTOMATON reports that Riot Games unveiled New Dawn, a major 2027 update featuring a substantially reworked client plus visual, gameplay, and champion-experience changes. More details are planned for January 2027.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report clearly attributes the announcement to Riot Games and states the update name, 2027 direction, new client, and January follow-up. Historical “LoL 2” speculation is not carried into this entry.
entries.timeNote: Published at 06:24 Beijing time on November 15, inside the fixed edition window; the update is confirmed only from 2027, with more information due in January.

entries.headline: Grand Theft Auto VI album track list appears to leak days before launch
entries.summary: IGN reports that a retailer-style video appears to reveal the full track list for Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album, while Rolling Stone says it confirmed the list with its sources. Rockstar is not shown confirming it in the packet, so no tracks are reproduced here.
entries.verification: The opened IGN report supports the existence of the apparent retail video and Rolling Stone’s sourcing claim, but the packet contains no first-party Rockstar confirmation. The item is therefore labeled unconfirmed.
entries.timeNote: Published at 07:00 Beijing time on November 15, inside the fixed edition window; the game and album are reported for November 19, 2026.

entries.headline: Love Locks, a co-op game about removing 100,000 padlocks, launches December 4
entries.summary: Blue Brain Games announced Collision Games’ cleanup simulator Love Locks, in which players remove 100,000 “love locks” from a bridge in Paris. It supports up to five-player co-op and is planned for PC via Steam on December 4.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report clearly relays the publisher announcement and confirms the developer, 100,000 locks, up to five-player co-op, PC via Steam, and the December 4 date.
entries.timeNote: Published at 11:14 Beijing time on November 14, inside the fixed edition window; launch is planned for December 4, 2026.

entries.headline: Super Meat Boy Again+ announced with more than 300 levels and refreshed art and music
entries.summary: Team Meat announced Super Meat Boy Again+ for PC via Steam. It adds new art, music, cutscenes, characters, levels, secrets, and unlockables, with more than 300 stages and original composer Danny B returning. No release date was announced.
entries.verification: The opened Gematsu and Denfaminicogamer reports independently relay the Team Meat announcement and agree on the PC release and refreshed content; the latter also specifies more than 300 stages and Danny B’s return.
entries.timeNote: Gematsu published at 12:36 Beijing time on November 14 and Denfaminicogamer at 16:58, both inside the fixed edition window. No release date was announced.

entries.headline: Halo: Campaign Evolved will add Firefight in a free update
entries.summary: Xbox announced that Halo: Campaign Evolved will receive Firefight as a free update. The cooperative PvE mode centers on surviving increasingly dangerous enemy waves, with more details due during Halo Fest over the weekend beginning December 12.
entries.verification: The opened PC Gamer report clearly attributes the news to Xbox and confirms the free Firefight update, its cooperative PvE format, and the Halo Fest follow-up. The author’s opinion about the remake is omitted.
entries.timeNote: Published at 22:49 Beijing time on November 14, inside the fixed edition window; more details are due during Halo Fest beginning the weekend of December 12.

entries.headline: Factorio player builds a no-mod “music player” with 2,499 speakers
entries.summary: Player Nablanaut used 2,499 programmable speakers to recreate music in Factorio without mods and released FactoTune, a browser tool that converts music files into in-game blueprints. Building it requires game version 2.1 and the Space Age expansion.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report identifies the creator, 2,499-speaker setup, FactoTune’s purpose, and the version 2.1 and Space Age requirements. It is presented as a player creation, not an official feature.
entries.timeNote: Published at 15:48 Beijing time on November 14, inside the fixed edition window; the original player demonstration is dated November 8.

entries.headline: Minecraft previews its first 2027 Game Drop with throwing discs and full Bedrock off-hand support
entries.summary: Mojang Studios unveiled Minecraft’s first Game Drop of 2027. It adds throwing discs that return, ricochet, and pass through multiple enemies, while Bedrock Edition will expand off-hand use to every item.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report attributes the reveal to Mojang Studios and the TwitchCon San Diego 2026 stream, and clearly describes both features. No launch date is inferred.
entries.timeNote: Published at 08:07 Beijing time on November 15, inside the fixed edition window; the update is confirmed only as the first Game Drop of 2027.

entries.headline: Grand Theft Auto VI introduces mechanisms designed to encourage empathy
entries.summary: Rockstar North co-studio head Rob Nelson says Grand Theft Auto VI is the first game in the series to include mechanisms that encourage empathy. Player actions will affect how the game unfolds, though the design is not intended to punish familiar GTA play styles.
entries.verification: The opened IGN report quotes Nelson’s Guardian interview and distinguishes his design comments from the writer’s speculation. No unspecified system is presented as confirmed.
entries.timeNote: Published at 01:19 Beijing time on November 15, inside the fixed edition window; the game is planned for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S on November 19, 2026.

entries.headline: Mattias Lilja will take over as Paradox Interactive CEO in January 2027
entries.summary: Paradox Interactive announced that deputy CEO Mattias Lilja will succeed Fredrik Wester as CEO on January 4, 2027. Lilja has worked on titles including Victoria II, Stellaris, and Hearts of Iron IV.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report attributes the change to a Paradox board decision and confirms the outgoing and incoming CEOs, effective date, and Lilja’s relevant background.
entries.timeNote: Published at 16:38 Beijing time on November 14, inside the fixed edition window; the company announcement is dated November 11 and the transition takes effect January 4, 2027.

entries.headline: Sega partially restores ALL.Net and Aime as several arcade games resume trial operation
entries.summary: SEGA FAVE says parts of ALL.Net and Aime have returned after services were suspended following unauthorized access. Ongeki, Kantai Collection Arcade, SEGA NET Mahjong MJ Arcade, and other titles have begun trial operation.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report attributes the update to SEGA FAVE and identifies the partial restoration, trial-operation scope, and affected services. It is not described as a full recovery.
entries.timeNote: Published at 09:31 Beijing time on November 15, inside the fixed edition window; SEGA FAVE announced the partial restoration on November 15.

entries.headline: Sandbox MMORPG BitCraft Online exits Early Access with Japanese language support
entries.summary: Clockwork Labs released BitCraft Online in full for PC via Steam on November 14. The launch brings content and system improvements as well as full Japanese language support.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report and headline evidence attribute the launch to Clockwork Labs and confirm the November 14 full release, PC platform, launch improvements, and Japanese support. Concurrency figures are not treated as a quality judgment.
entries.timeNote: Published at 13:22 Beijing time on November 14, inside the fixed edition window; the full release launched the same day.
